subject: P1: hintPenalty:true corrupts scoring and leaks 'true pts' into the hint UI (93 boxes)
description:
Described in SITREP but never logged as a task until now. BoxEngine.js:1828 'const base = hint.penalty || scoring.hintPenalty || -50;'. A hint with penalty: 0 (a legitimately FREE hint) is FALSY, so the chain falls through to scoring.hintPenalty, which is the BOOLEAN true in 249 configs. BoxEngine.js:1948 then calls this.addScore(effectivePenalty), so revealing a free hint does score += true = +1 point instead of applying a penalty; co-op passes the same value into CoOpSync.revealHintAtomically so it reaches a Firestore transaction; four summary rows render hintsUsed.length * true. STUDENT-VISIBLE, CONFIRMED ON PRODUCTION NT1 2026-09-09: the hint panel renders the literal button label 'Reveal Hint (true pts)' alongside correct siblings '-10 / -25 / -50 pts'. NT1 carries scoring.hintPenalty: true at dispatch config.js:648. 249 configs affected, 93 actively mis-scoring. The fix is NOT simply ?? for || -- that changes behaviour for every box relying on the fallback, and hintPenalty: true is meaningless data that needs an authorial decision per box. Own vote, own harness.
[2026-09-09 21:57] FIXED on branch fix-378-hint-price, awaiting Chris. Root cause was wider than the label: FIVE call sites read scoring.hintPenalty directly as 'hintsUsed.length * (scoring.hintPenalty || -50)' -- score-detail panel, completion screen, completion report, markdown export -- where the boolean true coerces to 1 and renders a POSITIVE number in a red negative-styled row. All now route through one resolver, _scoringHintPenalty. Impact measured across 3479 hints in 292 configs by the committed _tools/hexos/hint-price-impact.js: 2806 unchanged, 673 free hints restored to free, ZERO numeric swings, ZERO new fallbacks. HINT-002 (LOW) now tracks the 244 configs still carrying a non-numeric hintPenalty -- no longer student-visible, but meaningless data the next author will inherit as a silent -50.
